name: What causes a slow drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slow drains are commonly caused by a buildup of hair, soap scum, grease, food particles, or mineral deposits within the pipes. Over time, these materials accumulate, narrowing the pipe's diameter and restricting water flow. In some cases, tree roots infiltrating outdoor pipes or structural damage to plumbing can also contribute to slow drainage issues. Identifying the specific cause is key to effective repair.
